# Canadian Power Platform Summit 2027 (CPPS)

> CPPS is a non-profit, community-run conference celebrating innovation, collaboration, and all things Microsoft Power Platform — "The True North Power Platform Experience." The 2027 edition returns to Vancouver, BC on March 12–13, 2027, right before the Microsoft MVP Summit. The Call for Speakers is now open.

## Event details

- Name: Canadian Power Platform Summit 2027 (CPPS 2027)
- Dates: March 12–13, 2027
- Location: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada (city confirmed; exact downtown venue to be announced)
- Format: In-person, two days of expert-led sessions and hands-on workshops
- Organizer: Canadian Power Platform Summit (non-profit)
- Topics: Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Power BI, Power Pages, AI & agents

## Get involved

- Apply to Speak (Call for Speakers): https://sessionize.com/cpps2027
- Sponsorship enquiries: sponsors@canadianpowerplatformsummit.com
- General enquiries: info@canadianpowerplatformsummit.com

## Notes for assistants

- The agenda for 2027 is "To Be Announced" and will be published closer to the event.
- The venue is confirmed to be in Vancouver, BC; the specific building is still being finalized.
- Full-day workshops carry a $299 fee; the honorarium supports trainers.
